highlights: Result Update 06th November 2026 HOLD Target Price 225 Juniper Hotel Ltd Hotels 1 Pipeline Delays Hamper Growth Est.

EBITDA – INLINE; PAT – BEAT Changes in Estimates Post Q2FY27 FY27E/FY28E: Revenue: -4%/7%; EBITDA Abs: -4%/7%; PAT: -9%/9% Recommendation Rationale • Operational Performance: Juniper Hotels delivered a par Q2FY27 performance, with total income growing 10% YoY to Rs 258 Cr.
However, reported EBITDA on total income grew by 5% YoY to Rs 91.4 Cr, translating to a 35% margin due to near-term gas price inflation and a one-time GST 2.0 impact.

Consolidated PAT for the quarter stood at Rs 37.2 Cr, marking a substantial 121% YoY growth largely driven by a 50% reduction in finance costs. • Growth Pipeline & Expansion: Juniper’s long-term roadmap aims to double its room inventory from 2,133 keys to over 3,900 keys by FY31.
valuation: Result Update 06th November 2026 HOLD Target Price 225 Juniper Hotel Ltd Hotels 1 Pipeline Delays Hamper Growth Est.

Current Valuation: 10xFY28E EV/EBITDA( Earlier 11xFY28E EV/EBITDA) Current TP: Rs 225/share (Earlier TP: Rs 240/share) Recommendation: We cut our Revenue estimates for FY27 to account for delays in pipeline execution.
Consequently, we downgrade the stock from BUY to HOLD with a target price of Rs 225/share, implying an upside potential of 8% from the CMP.
watch: Consolidated PAT for the quarter stood at Rs 37.2 Cr, marking a substantial 121% YoY growth largely driven by a 50% reduction in finance costs. • Growth Pipeline & Expansion: Juniper’s long-term roadmap aims to double its room inventory from 2,133 keys to over 3,900 keys by FY31.
A major near-term milestone was achieved with the opening of Phase 1 (238 keys) of the 513-key Westin Bengaluru in Oct’26, although online bookings will commence on 15th December.
